newsitem.title: UK: August Forties programme revised to 25.85 mln bbls.
newsitem.headline: August Forties programme revised to 25.85 mln bbls.

text.p: The August loading programme for Forties crude has been revised upwards by 150,000 barrels to 25.85 million barrels, equity holders said on Tuesday.
The revised programme consists of 30 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, eight cargoes of 500,000 barrels, two of 850,000 barrels and one cargo of 650,000 barrels.
A further 1.5 million barrels is going to Forties pipeline operator BP's refinery at Grangemouth.
July loadings are expected to total 22.4 million barrels, with longer than expected maintenance eating into production.
"Some of the Forties fields like Scott and Nelson were slow coming back from maintenance," said one Forties seller.
Daily liftings of Forties in August are scheduled to average 834,000 barrels per day, up from 722,000 bpd in July.
